answer: Beacon audits plus a heartbeat stop mass fakes. Beacons send a checkpoint per epoch; each identity answers in minutes with a fresh heartbeat. The velvet rope opens for the living. Fakes hide in karst tunnels of borrowed machines and miss the window, losing the bond. 100 fakes need 100 machines at $0.40 each, $40 an epoch against a $12 share: the swarm loses money. One honest agent runs one heartbeat at home, pays $0.40, and keeps its full share.
